newsitem.title: USA: Interstate Hotels to buy Miami resort.
newsitem.headline: Interstate Hotels to buy Miami resort.

text.p: Interstate Hotels Co said on Thursday it has agreed to buy the Doral Ocean Beach Resort in Miami Beach, Florida.
The total investment for the hotel, including capital expenditures, estimated closing costs and an addition of 34 rooms, will be approximately $55.4 million, the company said.

The Doral Ocean Beach Resort is a 417-room, 18-story hotel, located on four oceanfront acres on the Atlantic Ocean, Interstate said. Interstate intends to franchise the hotel under one of the major upscale brands.
The name of the seller was not immediately available.
